from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,re,time,datetime,hashlib,os
root=Path.cwd();base=Path('docs/audits/push-readiness-20261025');old=json.loads((base/'full6-admission-20261031.json').read_text());rows=[]
for cmd in [['/usr/bin/vm_stat'],['/usr/sbin/sysctl','-n','hw.memsize'],['/usr/sbin/sysctl','-n','kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level']]:
 start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();t=time.monotonic_ns();r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15);rows.append({'command':cmd,'started_utc':start,'elapsed_ns':time.monotonic_ns()-t,'exit_status':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr});assert r.returncode==0
vm=rows[0]['stdout'];total=int(rows[1]['stdout']);pressure=int(rows[2]['stdout']);page=int(re.search(r'page size of (\d+)',vm)[1]);names=['Pages active','Pages inactive','Pages speculative','Pages wired down','Pages occupied by compressor','Pages purgeable','File-backed pages'];counts={name:int(re.search(r'^'+re.escape(name)+r':\s+(\d+)',vm,re.M)[1]) for name in names};used=(sum(counts[x] for x in names[:5])-sum(counts[x] for x in names[5:]))*page;pct=used*100/total
cmd=old['independent_saved_counter_parser']['command'].copy();cmd[2]='t='+str(total);r=subprocess.run(cmd,input=vm,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15);assert r.returncode==0 and abs(float(r.stdout.strip())-pct)<1e-9
slots=['.artifacts/push-readiness-20261025/local-full-ci-12.state.json','.artifacts/push-readiness-20261025/local-full-ci-12.live.log','.artifacts/t296/push-readiness-20261025-full12.json',str(base/'local-full-ci-12.json'),str(base/'local-full-ci-12.log.gz')];assert all(not Path(x).exists() and not Path(x).is_symlink() for x in slots)
selectors={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith('FSMGEN_')};assert not any(k in selectors for k in ['FSMGEN_T296_CHECKPOINT','FSMGEN_SOURCE_QUERY_ALL','FSMGEN_VIAL_SCALE_EXACT','FSMGEN_T296_SHARD_INDEX','FSMGEN_T296_SHARD_COUNT'])
packet={'owner':'PUBLICATION-REGRESSION-REPAIRS.28','source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'contract':old['contract'],'commands':rows,'capacity':{'page_bytes':page,'physical_bytes':total,'counters':counts,'used_bytes':used,'used_pct':pct},'kernel_pressure_level':pressure,'independent_saved_counter_parser':{'command':cmd,'input':'commands[0].stdout','exit_status':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr,'scope':'Independent parser of the same adopted formula/raw VM sample; not another Mach sampler.'},'new_exclusive_slots':slots,'ambient_fsmgen_selectors':selectors,'limits':{'host_pct':88,'descendant_mib':4096},'admitted':pct<88 and pressure==1,'director_statement':'I paused 3 of my other projects, is the memory pressure acceptable now for you ?','scope':'Current admission only, no future headroom guarantee or original-cutoff attribution. No process termination/cache deletion/guard change.','producer':{'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}
path=base/'full12-admission-after-pause-20261102.json';assert not path.exists();path.write_text(json.dumps(packet,indent=2)+'\n');assert packet['admitted'];print(json.dumps({'capacity_pct':pct,'pressure':pressure,'slots_absent':len(slots)}))
